map.乘用车常用阻尼比在 0.2~0.35 之间：偏低（<0.2）车身起伏衰减慢、余振: Passenger cars usually run a damping ratio of 0.2~0.35: too low (<0.2) leaves body motion decaying slowly with much residual bounce, giving a "boat-like" feel over undulating roads; too high (>0.45) transmits impacts harshly, hurts comfort and heats the dampers. Around 0.25~0.35 is the usual compromise between comfort and control.
map.圆柱螺旋弹簧刚度 k = G·d⁴ ÷ (8·D³·n)，其中 G 为材料剪切模: A cylindrical coil spring has rate k = G·d⁴ ÷ (8·D³·n), where G is the material shear modulus, d the wire diameter, D the mean coil diameter and n the number of active coils. Wire diameter enters to the fourth power and dominates: 10% more wire diameter gives about 46% more rate. Adjust wire diameter and coil count first, watching both bind height and the risk of coil clash.
map.💡 簧上固有频率应在 1.0~1.5 Hz 附近，且与簧下固有频率拉开 4 倍以: 💡 Keep sprung natural frequency near 1.0~1.5 Hz and at least four times clear of the unsprung frequency, so road input cannot excite body and wheel resonance at once.

map.重载或升高车体时重算弹簧压缩量与限位，防止触底。: Under heavy loads or a raised body, recalculate spring compression and stop travel to avoid bottoming out.
map.固有频率与阻尼比核算: Natural frequency and damping ratio check
map.簧上质量 400 kg、弹簧刚度 28 N/mm 时，固有频率 f = (1÷2: With sprung mass 400 kg and spring rate 28 N/mm, natural frequency f = (1÷2π)·√(28000÷400) ≈ 1.33 Hz, inside the 1.0~1.4 Hz comfort zone; critical damping Cc = 2√(28000×400) ≈ 6693 N·s/m, so a damping coefficient of 2000 N·s/m gives ζ ≈ 0.30, within the usual 0.20~0.35 passenger-car range and a good match. A load of 380 kg per wheel corresponds to about 133 mm of static deflection, leaving some 67 mm of compression travel from 200 mm of damper stroke. Following the fourth-power wire relation (k ∝ d⁴), going from 12 mm to 13 mm wire lifts rate about 38%, raising frequency to roughly 1.56 Hz and leaving the comfort zone, so damper valving must change in step.
map.簧硬好还是软好？: Is a stiffer or softer spring better?
map.硬簧支撑强、侧倾小但颠；软簧舒适但易触底、侧倾大。按用途调，运动取向加硬、家用偏: Stiff springs support better and roll less but ride harsh; soft springs ride comfortably but bottom out and roll more. Tune to purpose: firmer for sport, softer for family use, and match the damper valving.
map.为什么改短簧要换减震？: Why do lowering springs require new dampers?
map.短簧改变工作行程与预载，原厂减震可能触底或拉伸超限，须选匹配长度与阻尼的减震器，: Lowering springs change the working travel and preload, so standard dampers can bottom out or over-extend; fit units of matching length and valving, or they will fail and may even leak.
map.簧上固有频率宜在 1.0~1.5 Hz、阻尼比 0.20~0.35；改刚度须同步: Keep sprung natural frequency at 1.0~1.5 Hz with a damping ratio of 0.20~0.35; any change of spring rate must be matched by damper valving
